arguments.message:
The SSO button only appears for email domains that have been set up for SSO and only after the identity‑provider sync has created the user’s account. If you’re a new hire, you might be signing in before the next scheduled sync runs, or the account may not yet exist on the IdP side – Meridian never creates SSO accounts on its own.

An admin can confirm whether the account exists by going to **Settings → People**; SSO‑provisioned accounts are marked with the identity provider they came from. If the account isn’t listed, wait for the next sync or ensure the user is created in the IdP.

Also, enabling SSO does not automatically disable password sign‑in for existing staff; both methods remain available until an admin turns password sign‑in off in **Settings → Security → SSO → Require SSO**.
